title: Fez Delivery Integration — API Reference

changelog.3.0.0: createStripePayment now uses live Fez delivery cost (removed geocoding). Added Stripe endpoints #6 and #7. Fixed exchange rate direction bug (NGN*rate not NGN/rate). Stripe handles all international routes; Paystack handles Nigeria-only.
changelog.2.0.0: createPaymentOnline (Paystack) now uses live Fez delivery cost instead of distance-based geocoding. Removed shipmentMethod param; added weight param.

authentication: All endpoints require Bearer token in Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
note: FedEx and DHL integrations are commented out pending API approval. All delivery is handled by Fez Delivery.

routeDetection.description: The system automatically detects the delivery route from vendor and buyer country fields in their profiles.
routeDetection.domestic: vendor.country = Nigeria AND buyer.country = Nigeria → FEZ_STANDARD
routeDetection.export: vendor.country = Nigeria AND buyer.country = foreign → FEZ_EXPORT
routeDetection.import: vendor.country = foreign AND buyer.country = Nigeria → FEZ_IMPORT

endpoints.name: Get Carrier Rates (Quote delivery cost before payment)
endpoints.description: Returns live Fez delivery rates for a given order. Automatically detects route type (domestic / export / import) from vendor and buyer country profiles. Domestic returns NGN price; export returns NGN price; import returns origin currency price (£, $, etc.).

weight.description: Total shipment weight in kg. Overrides summing package weights.

endpoints.name: Create Carrier Shipment (after payment confirmed)
endpoints.description: Creates a real Fez shipment and stores the waybill number against the Tracking record. Automatically selects domestic, export, or import Fez flow based on vendor and buyer country. No label is generated (Fez uses waybill numbers, not PDF labels).

endpoints.name: Initialize Paystack Payment (Fez Delivery Included)
endpoints.description: Initializes a full Paystack payment for a material order. Calls the Fez delivery API live to get the real shipping cost, adds it to the quoted amount, and returns a Paystack authorization URL the buyer opens to pay. The old distance/geocoding formula has been fully removed — delivery cost comes entirely from Fez resp.totalCost.

params.reviewId: MongoDB ObjectId of the review (quote) to pay for

amount.description: The review totalCost (material + workmanship + platform tax + commission). This is the quote amount the tailor produced.

address.description: Buyer's full delivery address. Stored on the order record for dispatch purposes only — not used for distance calculation.
address.example: 12 Aba Road, Port Harcourt, Rivers State

weight.description: Estimated shipment weight in kg passed directly to Fez. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

paymentStatus.description: Defaults to 'full payment'. Pass 'part payment' for part-pay flows.

deliveryRouteLogic.description: Route is detected automatically from buyer and vendor country profiles — no manual selection needed.
deliveryRouteLogic.domestic_NG_NG: Calls fezGetDeliveryCost({ pickUpState: vendor.state, recipientState: buyer.state, weight }) → Fez POST /order/cost
deliveryRouteLogic.export_NG_World: Calls fezGetExportCost({ pickUpState: vendor.state, countryName: buyer.country, weight }) → Fez GET /orders/export-price
deliveryRouteLogic.import_World_NG: Calls fezGetImportCost({ destinationState: buyer.state, countryName: vendor.country, weight }) → Fez POST /orders/import-price

howTotalIsCalculated.step1: amount = review.totalCost (material + workmanship + tax + commission — already computed by tailor during createReview)
howTotalIsCalculated.step2: shipping = fezRate.amount (live from Fez API — base cost + VAT + fuel surcharge)

endpoints.name: Initialize Paystack Part Payment
endpoints.description: Initializes a Paystack part payment for a material order. No delivery fee is charged at this stage — buyer pays the agreed partial amount only. Delivery fee is not included (deliveryFee: 0). Full delivery payment happens at the final payment step.

amount.description: Partial amount the buyer is paying now (NGN). No delivery fee is added.

address.description: Buyer's delivery address (stored on order record).
address.example: 12 Aba Road, Port Harcourt, Rivers State

endpoints.name: Initialize Stripe Payment — International (Fez Delivery Included)
endpoints.description: Initializes a Stripe Checkout session for international orders (or any cross-border transaction). Calls the Fez delivery API live for the shipping cost, converts it to USD, and returns a Stripe checkout URL. Replaces the old geocoding+distance delivery formula entirely. Use this endpoint when either the buyer or the vendor is outside Nigeria. For both-Nigerian orders use Paystack (#3) instead.

params.reviewId: MongoDB ObjectId of the review (quote) to pay for

amount.description: The review totalCost in NGN (material + workmanship + tax + commission). The endpoint converts to USD internally.

address.description: Buyer's delivery address. Stored on the order record — not used for distance calculation.

weight.description: Estimated shipment weight in kg, passed directly to Fez. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

exchangeRateLogic.meaning: 1 NGN = exchangeRate USD (e.g. 0.000650 means 1 USD ≈ 1538 NGN)

deliveryRouteLogic.export_NG_vendor_to_intl_buyer: fezGetExportCost({ pickUpState, countryName: buyer.country, weight }) → returns NGN → convert to USD via exchangeRate
deliveryRouteLogic.import_intl_vendor_to_NG_buyer: fezGetImportCost({ destinationState: buyer.state, countryName: vendor.country, weight }) → returns origin currency ($ or £) → treated as USD for Stripe
deliveryRouteLogic.both_international: No Fez delivery fee (Fez only covers routes involving Nigeria). deliveryFee = $0.
deliveryRouteLogic.both_nigeria: Use Paystack (#3) instead. Stripe still works but is unnecessary.

paymentCurrencyLogic.intl_buyer_ng_vendor: Stripe charges buyer in USD (review.totalCostUSD). Vendor wallet credited in NGN.
paymentCurrencyLogic.ng_buyer_intl_vendor: NGN quote converted to USD via exchangeRate. Vendor wallet credited in USD.
paymentCurrencyLogic.both_international: Stripe charges buyer in USD (review.totalCostUSD). Vendor wallet credited in USD.
paymentCurrencyLogic.both_nigeria: Falls through — amount is NGN, no USD conversion.

paymentGatewayRouting.description: Which payment gateway to use depends on where the buyer is located.
paymentGatewayRouting.use_paystack: Both buyer AND vendor are in Nigeria → POST /api/v1/material/createPaymentOnline/:reviewId
paymentGatewayRouting.use_stripe: Either buyer OR vendor (or both) is outside Nigeria → POST /api/v1/stripe/make-payment/:reviewId
paymentGatewayRouting.currency: Paystack charges NGN. Stripe always charges USD.

importantNotes: shipmentMethod (express/cargo/regular) is fully removed from BOTH Paystack and Stripe payment endpoints. Do not send it — it is ignored.
All delivery costs (Paystack and Stripe) come exclusively from the live Fez API (resp.totalCost). No backend geocoding or distance math is used anywhere.
The correct call flow: (1) GET /deliveryRate/carrier-rates/:reviewId to preview Fez delivery price, (2) POST to the appropriate payment endpoint with amount + address + weight.
amount in both payment endpoints = review.totalCost (already includes material + workmanship + platform tax + commission). Do NOT add delivery yourself — the endpoint adds it from Fez.
Exchange rate field on review (review.exchangeRate) defines 1 NGN = X USD (e.g. 0.000650). To convert NGN→USD multiply; to convert USD→NGN divide.

Stripe import delivery fee: Fez returns cost in origin currency (£ for UK vendors, $ for US vendors). The value is passed directly to Stripe as USD. For UK vendors this creates a slight GBP/USD discrepancy — production should add a proper FX conversion.
Both-international orders (neither buyer nor vendor in Nigeria) receive $0 delivery fee from Stripe — Fez only supports routes involving Nigeria.
Fez does not generate PDF shipping labels. The waybillNumber (carrierTrackingNumber) is the shipment identifier.
Phone numbers stored on buyer/vendor profiles must be Nigerian local format (e.g. 08012345678). The system normalizes +234 prefix automatically.
Route detection is fully automatic based on buyer.country and vendor.country profile fields. No manual carrier selection needed.
For export orders, weight is rounded up to the nearest Fez weight tier (0.5kg, 1kg, 1.5kg, 2kg … up to 10kg).
FEZ_ENV=sandbox in .env uses Fez sandbox API. Change to production for live orders.
Tracking works for all three service types (FEZ_STANDARD, FEZ_EXPORT, FEZ_IMPORT) using the same waybill format.
